target.name: WISE 0855
target.description: 250 K free-floating planetary-mass Y dwarf at 2.28 pc with extreme proper motion (~8.1 arcsec/yr westward). Faint below 3.5 µm; thermally bright in 4-5 µm (D5/D6).
target.scientific_notes: Discovery coordinates 08h55m10.831s -7d14m42.53s (2010.5) propagated with pmra=-8123.7 mas/yr, pmdec=+673.2 mas/yr to 2025.8. Default FOV 0.15° keeps both discovery and 2025-2026 positions well inside the frame.
